theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Myth: All mutual funds are risky investments
body: Risk varies based on fund type, holding period, and your goals. Diversification helps manage risk across holdings.
caption: Different funds suit different risk appetites and timelines. Starting early with consistent investing can help smooth out market ups and downs. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingSmart #DiversificationMatters #LongTermWealth #DebunkingMyths
